FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(WEST COAST EXPRESSWAY (TAIPING-BANTING)) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (West Coast Expressway (Taiping-Banting)) (Amendment)

Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 26 June 2024.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(West Coast Expressway (Taiping-Banting)) Order 2020 [P.U. (A) 14/2020], which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)

by substituting for subsubparagraph (b) the following subsubparagraph:

"(b) kilometre 193.59 at coordinates N 455672.836, E 310764.161 of the

RSO Geosentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 277.67

at coordinates N 529394.338, E 303568.131 of the RSO Geosentric

(GDM 2000) Grid including the Kg. Lekir Interchange, Kg. Lekir

Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Sitiawan Interchange, Sitiawan Entry/Exit Toll

Plaza, Sitiawan North Interchange, Sitiawan North Entry/Exit Toll Plaza,

Changkat Chermin Interchange, Changkat Chermin Entry/Exit Toll

Plaza, Beruas Interchange, Beruas Entry/Exit Toll Plaza,

Trong Interchange, Trong Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Taiping South

Interchange, Taiping South Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its link roads; and".

";
